# bloxone_cdc_flows (Data Source)

Retrieves information about existing Data Flows.

The Data Flow object connects a source, one or more destinations, and optional ETL filters to define how data moves through Cloud Data Connector (CDC).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get CDC Flows filtered by an attribute
data "bloxone_cdc_flows" "example_by_attribute" {
  filters = {
    name = "example_cdc_flow"
  }
}

# Get CDC Flows filtered by tag
data "bloxone_cdc_flows" "example_by_tag" {
  tag_filters = {
    site = "Site A"
  }
}

# Get all CDC Flows
data "bloxone_cdc_flows" "example_all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filters` (Map of String) Filter are used to return a more specific list of results. Filters can be used to match resources by specific attributes, e.g. name. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.
- `tag_filters` (Map of String) Tag Filters are used to return a more specific list of results filtered by tags. If you specify multiple filters, the results returned will have only resources that match all the specified filters.

### Read-Only

- `results` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results))

<a id="nestedatt--results"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results`

Required:

- `cdc_services` (List of String) The identifiers of the Data Connector services that run the flow, without the `infra/service/` prefix.
- `destinations` (List of Number) The identifiers of the destinations the flow sends data to.
- `name` (String) The name of the flow.
- `source` (Number) The identifier of the source the flow collects data from.
- `source_data_types` (List of String) The data types collected from the source, e.g. `RPZ_LOG` or `QUERY_RESP_LOG`.

Optional:

- `description` (String) The description of the flow.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Indicates whether the flow is enabled.
- `etl_filters` (List of Number) The identifiers of the ETL filters applied to the flow.
- `filter_expression` (String) The expression that combines the ETL filters of the flow, referring to them by name.
- `schedule_option` (String) The schedule option of the flow. Used with the Schedule source.
- `script_schedule` (String) The cron schedule of the flow, e.g. `0 0 0 */2 * * *`. Used with the Schedule source.
- `tags` (Map of String) The tags for the flow.

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) Time when the object has been created.
- `destination_ha` (Boolean) Indicates whether the flow sends data to its destinations in high availability mode.
- `id` (Number) The resource identifier.
- `source_log_types` (Attributes List) The log types and log fields collected from the source, derived by the backend from _source_data_types_. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--source_log_types))
- `updated_at` (String) Time when the object has been updated. Equals to _created_at_ if not updated after creation.

<a id="nestedatt--results--source_log_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.source_log_types`

Read-Only:

- `log_fields` (Attributes List) The log fields collected for the log type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--results--source_log_types--log_fields))
- `log_subtypes` (List of String) The log subtypes of the log type.
- `log_type` (String) The log type, e.g. `RPZ_LOG`.

<a id="nestedatt--results--source_log_types--log_fields"></a>
### Nested Schema for `results.source_log_types.log_fields`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The identifier of the log field.
- `name` (String) The name of the log field.
- `required` (Boolean) Indicates whether the log field is always collected.
